limitations: Prior LevelHistoryQKV already used zero-sum differences with QK bound/confidence/older source/head; this isolates a current-condition V-only constraint, not a new zero-DC idea.
V constant-feature gain and small-quantity positive bias motivate but do not establish causal connection. No evidence of explosive weights.
Fewer degrees of freedom (576->512), short-history boundary change and effective optimizer/weight-decay parameterization are included in the intervention.
Q/K structure remains free but learns fresh weights, not preservation of previous learned Q/K values.
Constant latent V preservation is not constant raw quantity preservation or a guarantee of calibrated full-model predictions.
Historical CNN5080/cuDNN91900 versus new5090/cuDNN92000 is a comparison limitation; no new CNN fits to remove it.
Repeated Test-informed exploration is not independent evaluation, universal generalization, statistical significance or causal proof.
